title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - isaac keller
content:
Goal: prep for weekly 1:1 with Samir (eng lead) - focus on API/Console progress, Dedicated autoscaling issues, Private deployment blockers, and customer asks.

Meeting details:
- Time: Tue 2026-03-03 10:00am PT
- Attendee: Samir Kapoor (eng lead), Isaac Keller (PM)
- Length: 30m

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick sync (5m)
   - wins since last week: hosted API v2 route metrics pipeline is in (small p50 improvement, see infra note).
   - customer highlight: ACME trial shows 20% lower token cost after caching suggestions.
2) Blockers & escalations (10m)
   - Dedicated autoscaling flakiness still happening under sustained bursts (ticket DEDIC-402). Observed: delayed scale-up, >30s to add GPU pod which violates throughput SLO for peak bursts.
   - Private deployment installer failing on KMS key rotation when HSM enabled (PRIV-221). Customer reported rollback needed.
   - Observability: Console tracing for cross-request correlation missing for batched requests (hard to debug prefix cache misses).
3) Roadmap alignment (8m)
   - API: propose small UX change for streaming -> function calling toggle in Console. Need eng estimate (2w?).
   - Console: rollout plan for per-route cost meters + alerts (MVP: cost-per-route + P95 latency). Coordinate with SRE and Analytics.
   - Dedicated: short-term mitigation = increase warm-pool size for bursty customers; long-term = improve scale decision heuristics.
4) Action items & next steps (7m)
   - confirm owners, set deadlines, and unblockers.

Quick notes / data points to reference:
- API metrics (last 7d): p50 token latency 60ms -> 48ms after kernel tweak (small test cluster). p95 token latency 420ms -> 380ms.
- Cost: avg cost per 1k tokens (hosted) = $0.68; Dedicated marginal cost depends on commit.
- Alerts: too many noisy error 5xx alerts from route /v1/generate when model-switch fallback fires. Likely misclassification in router policy config.

Open items from last 1:1 (status):
- INF-987 (throughput regression on model-x): Samir - investigating kernel selection differences; tentative root cause: quantization path divergence. Status: in_progress, expect update by 2026-03-05.
- Console per-route dashboards: Maya - dashboard mockups ready; need eng data endpoints. Status: waiting_on_eng.
- Internal evals failing for streaming correctness on edge cases: Isaac - added failing prompts to eval set; need SRE trace samples. Status: blocked_on_traces.

Discussion prompts for Samir:
- Can we prioritize a short spike (2-3d) to harden Dedicated scale-up? Proposal: attach a small stateful "fast-warm" pool to hotspot tenants. Tradeoffs?
- KMS rotation failure: should we introduce a fallback flow for older HSM firmware customers to avoid hard failures? Ops impact?
- Router policy fallback too aggressive -> causes 5xx noise. Can we change policy to be more conservative for first 2 retries?

Action items (capture during meeting):
- Samir: scope spike for Dedicated warm-pool prototype, estimate and dev owner (due 2026-03-10).
- Isaac: open a Confluence page outlining the warm-pool proposal + cost model + rollout plan (due 2026-03-05). Linked: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Warm-Pool-Proposal
- Samir: assign eng to debug PRIV-221 installer KMS rotation; capture failing logs and reproduction steps (due 2026-03-06).
- Maya: finalize Console per-route cost mockups and handoff data contract to eng (due 2026-03-04).
- Eng/SRE: triage router fallback policy - temporary change to reduce retries, and add a flag to route that disables aggressive fallback for critical tenants (done by 2026-03-08).
- Isaac: follow up with ACME CS contact about Dedicated trial metrics and capture SLA expectations (due 2026-03-04).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep notes rough - this doc will be updated in-meeting.
- Remember to push for "observable-first" changes: instrument before optimizing.
- If Samir pushes back on warm-pool cost, have numbers ready (approx $Xk/mo per pool per 8 GPUs) - get precise from finance spreadsheet.

Misc references / tickets to mention:
- INF-987: throughput regression (kernel/quantization)
